about_the_game:
Introduction

[Warning] Low Battery...

Low Battery is a Sokoban-like puzzle game set against the backdrop of a robot factory. You play as a robot working to recycle power, tasked with maneuvering other units to designated zones to reclaim their energy.

But every time you move, you also cost power. Once your energy is depleted, you will be immobilized.

Ruthlessly drain energy from your surroundings, or meticulously calculate every move? You must find the perfect balance between mission completion and energy conservation.

Power is finite. Plan your route with extreme caution.

KEY FEATURES

  • Hardcore Logic Challenges: Designed for veterans of Sokoban and logic puzzles, offering a fresh resource-management twist that sets it apart from traditional Sokoban games.

  • 6 Themed Chapters: Progress through distinct environments, each sequentially introducing unique mechanics that change how you approach puzzles.

  • Overworld Puzzles: The world map isn't just a menu—figuring out how to access certain levels is a puzzle in itself.

  • Over 100 Handcrafted Puzzles: Experience a wide array of ingenious designs, all revolving around and evolving the core "Power" mechanic.

Instruction

  • WSAD - Move

  • Z - Undo

  • R - Restart

  • Esc - Bact to title

  • Click an adjacent robot to absorb power.
